lc_person: Moshé Burstein (born 1906), author of Self-government of the Jews in Palestine since 1900, a Columbia University dissertation published in 1934.
item_person: Moshe Avidor (1906–1985), educator, also catalogued as Moshe Burstein; author of the same work.

evidence.says: LC heading is Burstein, Moshé, 1906-. Its source note cites Self-government of the Jews in Palestine since 1900 (1976, copyright 1934), with Moshé Burstein on the title page. It links VIAF 97165702, GND 1055792600 and Wikidata Q7068895.
Q7068895 is labelled Moshe Avidor and described as an educator; birth year 1906, death year 1985, LC identifier no2001083846, VIAF 97165702 and GND 1055792600.

GND preferred name is Avidor, Moshe; variant name is Burstein, Moshe; dates are 1906–1985. The record lists Self-government of the Jews in Palestine since 1900 and explicitly links LC no2001083846 and Q7068895.

Catalogues Self-government of the Jews in Palestine since 1900 by Moshé Burstein, published in 1934, with a Columbia University Ph.D. thesis note. This matches the supplied AHA dissertation title, institution and year.

notes: The name discrepancy is resolved by the GND variant-name record and matching work and identifiers. LC, Wikidata and GND agree on birth year 1906. LC and Wikidata were read through their public JSON representations.
